$comment: Advisories the audit gate tolerates. Each entry must say why the risk does not apply here and what would remove it. An entry that stops matching a real advisory fails the gate, so this file cannot silently rot.

allow.reason: DoS needs the parser to read an attacker-supplied ICNS file. The only caller is handleImageOptimization in worker/index.ts, whose fetchAsset resolves through env.ASSETS against the request origin, so it parses first-party build assets exclusively. public/ ships png, svg and webp only.
allow.blockedOn: vinext 1.x. Every non-vulnerable vinext (>= 1.0.0-beta.6) breaks notFound(): NEXT_NOT_FOUND escapes asynchronously and unknown week slugs answer 200 instead of 404, failing tests/rendered-html.test.mjs. Needs a migration, not a version bump.

allow.reason: Same parser, same caller: the JXL and HEIF loops need an attacker-supplied image, and the optimizer only ever reads this build's own assets. No JXL or HEIF file exists in the repository.
